description: This file defines React components for rendering a list of Kanban cards with drag-and-drop reordering and card addition functionalities. It manages state for adding new cards, handles drag-and-drop interactions within and across columns, and renders individual cards with visual feedback during operations.

classes.name: CardList
classes.description: React component for displaying and managing a list of Kanban cards within a column, supporting adding, reordering, and drag-and-drop operations.

classes.name: DnDKanbanCard
classes.description: React component that wraps a Kanban card with drag-and-drop capabilities for reordering and moving between columns.

methods.name: handleAddCard
methods.description: Handles form submission for adding a new card to the column, collecting form data and invoking addCard.

methods.name: attachRef
methods.description: Attaches drag-and-drop references to the card DOM element for React DnD.

methods.name: CardList({ column, cards: colCardsProp, isCompact = false })
DnDKanbanCard({ card, index, column, colCards, isCompact = false, canEdit = true })
